blocks.text: LOS ANGELES— Lakers guard Austin Reaves has a bruised heel that’s thought to be a minor injury, and NBA scoring leader Luka Doncic is fine after rolling his ankle in Los Angeles’ most recent game. Lakers coach JJ Redick said Friday that Doncic is expected to be available for their next game in Phoenix on Sunday, while Reaves is listed as day to day.
